title: Add Skip Button and Countdown Timer to Quiz Screen

requirements.summary: Add Skip button to quiz screen that advances to next question without selecting an answer and tracks skipped questions
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Skip' button is visible on every question card during the quiz except it either submits/ends the quiz on the last question or is replaced by a 'Finish' action.
Clicking Skip advances to the next question without requiring an answer selection.
Skipped questions are recorded distinctly (e.g., selectedAnswer = null or a sentinel value) in the answers array passed to onComplete.
The ResultsScreen correctly counts and displays the number of skipped questions.
The Skip button is styled consistently with the existing parchment/teal/gold theme.

file_operations.description: Add a Skip button alongside the Next button in the quiz UI. The button should call a handleSkip function that records the current question as skipped (by storing null or -1 as the selectedAnswer) in the answers array, then advances to the next question using setCurrentQuestionIndex. On the last question, either hide the Skip button or merge it with the submit action. Apply the existing parchment/teal/gold button styling (matching the theme used for other buttons in the app). Ensure the Skip button is disabled when already on the last question if a separate Finish button is shown.

Update the results calculation logic to count skipped questions. Check the answers array for entries where selectedAnswer is null or -1 (the skipped sentinel value). Display the skipped count in the results UI alongside correct and incorrect counts. Ensure the skipped questions are excluded from the correct/incorrect tallies so the total adds up correctly. Style the skipped count display consistently with the existing parchment/teal/gold theme.

requirements.summary: Add countdown timer to quiz screen that displays remaining time per question and auto-skips when time expires
acceptanceCriteria: A countdown timer is visible on the quiz card during the quiz, showing remaining time in MM:SS format.
The timer starts at 60 seconds when each new question is displayed and counts down in real time.
When the timer reaches 0, the question is automatically skipped and the quiz advances to the next question.
The timer resets to 60 seconds whenever the user moves to a new question (via Next, Skip, or auto-skip).
The timer text changes to red when 10 or fewer seconds remain.
The timer stops when the user selects an answer or manually clicks Next/Skip.

file_operations.description: Add a countdown timer state (timeRemaining) initialized to 60 seconds. Use useEffect to set up an interval that decrements timeRemaining by 1 every second. Display the timer prominently at the top of the quiz card near the question counter in MM:SS format (e.g., '01:00'). When timeRemaining reaches 0, automatically trigger the skip logic (same as handleSkip from REQ-47) to advance to the next question. Reset timeRemaining to 60 whenever currentQuestionIndex changes. Clear the interval when the user selects an answer or clicks Next/Skip. Apply conditional styling: use the teal/gold theme color when timeRemaining > 10, and switch to red text when timeRemaining <= 10. Ensure the timer stops and clears when the quiz completes.
